question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the following equation correct?

38 ÷ 19 × 11 - 357 + 17 = 226
solution:
We apply each option to the given equation and solve it using the BODMAS rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a6f93b0f8305d496162d41f65450f13e20c650df2dbe481929271174df469e9.png] 

Option 1) × and +

__38 ÷ 19__ + 11 - 357 × 17 = 226

2 + 11 - __357 ____× ____ 17__ = 226

__2 + 11__ - 6069 = 226

__13 - 6069__ = 226

6056 ≠ 226
